The barn floor is max(ground under its walls) + 1 (tools/lopunny_house.py's and tools/shrines.py's convention), the fold's floor is the ground's own top block, and the old working hangs under the barn floor at working.floor_below_barn_floor.

site.name: the Drovers' Hollow
site.why_not_the_wall: MEASURED 2026-10-02 from tools/ground.py, and the brief's premise does not hold. (1) Outside the Rift's own polygon (data/regions.json the_rift, which ends at z5392-5408 between x3592 and x4216) the southern country is a gentle savanna slope: from x3600 to x4800 at z5450-5600 the ground climbs y108 to y157 at about 1 in 25, and the only tall cells near z5400 are single-row spikes (y189-295 at x3700-3800 and x4100-4180, z5380-5410) on the polygon's own edge. A search of every mouth on a 2-block grid in x2900-5200, z5450-6900, facing each cardinal direction, for a 21 by 28 block footprint with 8 or more blocks of ground over a 3-high room found ONE site (2942, 6098), 980 blocks from the Rift; with 11 blocks (a 6-high cave-barn and the den's 4-block shell plus one) it found none. (2) Every site that does have the cover (8-33 blocks) lies INSIDE the_rift polygon (the arms' floors, z5000-5400), where tools/rift_sculpt.py has cut and re-walled the rim in the world (data/rift_sculpt.json rim, cut: the lip band is lowered to the floor and crags up to 110 high are built on it), so the heightmap is not the ground there and a carve measured on it would be wrong; the brief also keeps every Rift zone off limits. So there is no rock wall to cut a cave-barn into: the place is BUILT instead, the Lopunny house's pattern (a building, and a sealed room under it), and only the old working under it is carved, the Ursaluna den's shell-then-void way, under measured cover.
site.why_here: the dry ravine south-east of the Arrow Lake creek (data/landmarks.json arrow_lake_south_east_branch: 'water never', a dry ravine by design) widens here into a flat hollow, y98 from x3960 to x3988 between banks that rise to y105 on the west and y109 on the east (tools/ground.py, sampled every 4 blocks over x3924-4016, z5996-6100): a sheltered, dry, level floor where drovers would winter stock, and a bank on the east side deep enough to hold a working under it (the working's least cover is measured by the generator's report). It is the Rift Foot sub-region (data/regions.json rift_foot), on the southern country's open savanna, the Rift's southern arms 600 blocks north.
site.findable_from: Route 8 (data/route_paths.json route_08_blaine_to_giovanni) crosses this ravine at about (3980, 6186), 150 blocks south of the barn, and runs along its east bank past (4003-4043, 6161-6164). MEASURED 2026-10-02 (tools/drovers_hollow.py --report): the barn's ridge (3964, 114, 6023) is in clear sight of a standing eye from 74 of Route 8's walked points sampled every 4th within 250 blocks; the clearest is (4007, 6163). tools/drovers_hollow_audit.py re-derives the ridge and the sightline itself.
site.off_path: MEASURED 2026-10-02 from the pack's whole write box (x3958-4025, z6015-6048, the working included): 93 blocks from the nearest point of Route 8's or Victory Road's walked paths (data/route_paths.json), and 189 from Hornwall's anchor (re-measured 2026-10-02 after Hornwall moved to (4148, 5872); 199 from its old one) (data/resident_encounters.json hornwall (4200, 5920), placed by another builder). Outside every footprint and zone: the gulch zone (data/gulch_mine.json zone, z <= 5047), the seven Mega dens' approach boxes (all z <= 5392), the cove town (inside the gulch), every traced Rift region (data/rift_regions.json; the southmost ends at z5079), every town (gym8_town's box is 461 blocks south-west), and nothing in data/placements.json, data/towns.json or data/landmarks.json but the ravine itself lies within 130 blocks of the barn; the nearest other Habitat Block is 243 blocks away. The audit re-checks these from the files.

barn.why: a longbarn 27 blocks east-west by 15 north-south outside, its long axis along the hollow's width and its back (east) gable at the foot of the east bank: stone-footed (a cobblestone ring and base course), spruce-framed (stripped spruce log posts every 4 blocks, plank walls), under a steep spruce gable whose ridge runs east-west. The cattle doorway in the west gable is open (the doors are long gone); a man's doorway in the south wall leads to the fold.

loft.why: a hay loft over the east third, its plank floor 4 above the barn floor, so the spring and the well under it have three blocks of headroom; reached by a ladder on the north wall at x3976, and railed along its open west edge.

spring.why: the spring the Hollow is named for, at the back of the barn under the loft: a trough of three full water cauldrons across the aisle's end. Cauldrons, not water: minecraft:water is a spawn condition (data/spawn_blocks.json), a water cauldron is not, and the ravine is 'water never' (data/landmarks.json).

well.why: behind the spring, where the old drover dug after the water when it ran low: a one-block shaft from a trapdoor in the barn floor, a ladder on its west face, down to the old working. A low ring of mossy stone-brick slabs round the trapdoor marks it; a slab is a half step, so it is walked over.

working.measured: 2026-10-02, tools/drovers_hollow.py --report: barn floor y100, working floor y91, 590 void blocks; the least cover over a void block outside the barn's footprint is 5 at (3988, 94, 6022), exactly margin + 1, where the drift leaves the barn's east gable under the toe of the bank.
working.why: the 'deeper old working behind the spring' of the brief: older than the drovers, found when they dug for the water. A level drift 3 wide and 3 high runs east from the well's foot under the barn's east gable and into the bank, to a store 9 by 9 and 4 high under the bank. Carved the Ursaluna den's way (tools/ursaluna_cave.py): a stone shell filled SOLID first, reaching `margin` blocks beyond every void block and never into the top `keep_natural_top` blocks of a column, then the void cut out of it, so 'margin blocks of rock round every void' holds by construction. Every void block is below the hollow's floor; the cover over it (ground over its top block) is the generator's report and the audit's check: at least margin + 1 everywhere outside the barn's footprint, where the barn's own floor and foundation stand over it. Its floor is gravel in the drift and cobblestone in the store; stripped spruce props stand in its walls and beams in its roof (shell positions, never in the air).

lanterns.why: places are lit as towns (lanterns, never light blocks: docs/STATE.md 'Places are lit as towns'): lanterns on chains from the barn's ridge over the aisle, one hanging from the loft over the spring, one on the loft, lanterns on the fold's corner posts and on posts either side of the cattle doorway, and lanterns hanging from the old working's roof every 7 blocks and in the store. Not dark by design: the drovers used it.

fold.why: the fold, south of the barn across a 3-block lane: a spruce-fenced pen 19 by 15 outside, its trodden floor coarse dirt written into the ground's own top block (the ground there is y98-99, so the fence posts stand on it and each links to its neighbours at the same height), its gate on the north side facing the barn's south doorway. The Habitat Block keeps a small herd in it (herd below).

herd.why: an ACTIVATED Habitat Block in the middle of the fold floor, disguised as the floor (mimic minecraft:coarse_dirt), keeping up to 6 of the drovers' kind of Pokemon alive in the pen: the Lopunny cellar's and the Ursaluna den's pattern (data/habitat_blocks.json lopunny_superfan_cellar_ward). Miltank for the milk, Tauros, and Mudsdale for the hauling; Bouffalant is left out so that Hornwall stays the only one. All three are savanna-themed Normal or Ground types (data/encounter_design.json rules.themes.savanna) and none evolves further (Cobblemon 1.8.0 species data: tauros and miltank have no evolutions; Mudbray evolves into Mudsdale at 30, below the band, so only Mudsdale is spawned), and none is drawn as the substitute doll (modpack/manifest/client-pack-atm-subset.json). Levels are the Rift Foot's band, 43-53 (data/spawns.json subregions rift_foot: tier 8, basis Route 8), under tier 8's cap of 55.

npc.why: Owen Cray, the last of the Hollow's drovers, stands in the lane between the barn's south wall and the fold's gate, on a dirt path the pack writes into the ground's own top block, feet one above it: the first person a player reaches coming up the hollow from Route 8. Placed over RCON by R18HF after R17N (tools/reapply.py's "npc" action, as R18U places the den's watcher); his class ships in cobblers_dialogue, compiled from data/dialogue.json. His talk points at the find: the spring, the well behind it, the working.

find.why: a cache (data/rewards.json, ADR-002): reaching the store's east end grants the contents once per player through an advancement (tools/rewards_pack.py), and the barrel this pack places is scenery. Late-game, as the place is: the Rift Foot is tier 8, beside Giovanni's town; a Choice Band (held nowhere else in the campaign but by trainers, data/trainers.json) as the herd bull's brow-band, and three Moomoo Milk from the herd.

blocks.rule: vanilla 1.21.1 only, none a spawn condition in data/spawn_blocks.json (no water, no gravel's coloured neighbours, no wool, no white carpet). No chests (tools/portals_audit.py records a chest as a Gimmighoul condition) and no beds (a bed sets a respawn point, which the blackout's checkpoints own).
